Time and regime revisit — year-to-year change as the last juice

Plan plans/plan-time-regime-revisit.md, prefix u. Research commit f82c81a (report built at b9eed39); reference hkjc-mod@c860064 read-only. the 37-column B0 set is a research snapshot (configs/features/production.json), not the live production set. Generated by u08 from stage digests; no hand-copied numbers.

Verdict

5 pre-declared cycles, 39 blocks, both productions, years first: no block reaches the finalist bar, and no block's favourable sign survives drop-best-year. 0 of 78 block×production rows are favourable AND retain ≥40% of their magnitude without their best year. The recency grid (30–365 d contrasts) is flat at every horizon — the feature-side twin of O3's training-side result; trailing windows are noisier than decayed means; the era-break blocks, the environmental-drift departures, the colony family and the year-since-import follow-ups are null or harmful, and their large per-year swings are single-year source artifacts (the rail coding shift of 2018; ±0.005 swings on cohort and programme variables).

What the year tables do show is a regime, and it is not in the blocks' reach. The t campaign's survivors are favourable in 10/10 survivor-arms favourable in 2018 and 10/10 survivor-arms favourable in 2024, and in only 2/10 survivor-arms favourable in 2021. The market's favourite–longshot calibration slope drifts from 1.02 (2016) to 1.13 (2021) and stays above 1.04, the ensemble's blend weight tracks it (0.53 → 0.72) and the P0 scale steps 3.5 → 2.5: the instruments already absorb the drift the market shows, and 2021 — a year of ordinary market sharpness and wide edge — is where the runner-level features fail. Favourite status is odds-derived and in the 37 (Implied_Prob, market_rank), so a calibration-state feature is banned; this stays a diagnostic.

Cycle 4 corrects a shortcut. Cycle 1's flat fixed-horizon grid was first read as implying an adaptive null; that inference fails under horse heterogeneity, which is measured (Study I/II volatility persistence; next-run |residual| 0.80 vs 0.64 across prior-volatility terciles). Cycle 4 therefore tested adaptive windows with one fitted dynamic — forward per-horse half-life selection from strictly prior errors. The selection is not degenerate (30 d chosen for 25% of horse-starts, 540 d for 41%), so horses do differ in the horizon that tracks them — and the departure it yields is still null, the declared volatility rule is harmful, and the selected horizon itself is harmful as a feature. Heterogeneity is real; the market already tracks each horse at its own horizon.

Cycle 5 measures the two U5 items session 1 had argued away. Regime-discounted reliability (each past run's weight multiplied by a declared discount per season boundary crossed, per trainer change, per departed rider) and era-aware support gating were built at F4's 60 d horizon against the day-decayed companions E1/E2, and at 540 d against a companion built here. The discounts bite where the mechanism says they should — a mean discounted-weight share of 0.90 (season), 0.979 (trainer) and 0.9998 (colony) at 60 d, 0.70 for all three at 540 d — and the best block×production row is V9 horse_relz_ewm_540_shrunk at -0.018×1e-3 (4/7). At the horizon where every history straddles a boundary, the discounted 540 d state scores +0.053/+0.031 (B0/P0, ×1e-3) against its own undiscounted companion at -0.001/-0.018; the era-aware gate scores +0.060/+0.065 against the fixed gate at +0.006/+0.002. No row is eligible under the screen rule (favourable on ≥5 of 7 years, beats controls and its declared baseline).

The instrument half of U3 was run as well (u12). Production fits its temperature map, market blend and P0 scale on the prequential margins of the whole training window; seven era cells re-ran exactly that calibration on prior-only subsets (trailing 1/2/3/5 calendar years, out-of-fold rows only, the two together, post-2020/21-season) of the same forty members, with the expanding cell reproducing production to 0.0e+00/0.0e+00 (B0/P0) and t01's C to 0.0e+00. The best cell is trailing_1y under P0 at -0.335×1e-3 (5/8, interval [-1.19, +0.53]); the worst is trailing_1y under B0 at +0.484. No cell clears the finalist bar on either production: a shorter calibration memory does not track the drift better than the expanding fit that already absorbs it. The pattern is one-link: 4 of 7 cells are favourable under P0 and 0 of 7 under B0; the trailing cells average -0.25×1e-3 under P0 (carried by 2016, where a 1-3 year window fits a scale of 2.0-2.5 against the expanding 3.5) and +0.27 under B0, whose blend weight on a one-year window swings to 1.00. An expanding scale fit lags the 3.5 → 2.5 drift by a year or two; that is the anchored link's own calibration, not information about runners, and by plan §1 it is link repair — recorded for the instrument work, not promoted.

Stop condition. Per plan §8 the campaign continues while mechanistically distinct, data-supported ideas remain. After five cycles and the instrument cells every family the plan names has been measured (U1 recency, U2 fixed and adaptive windows, U3 era breaks as features AND era cells as instruments, U4 calendar, U4b environment, U5 colony levels AND regime-discounted reliability AND era-aware gating; U6 as diagnostic), each with its year table and drop-best-year. Every one is null or harmful; within this repository's sources the backlog of distinct ideas is empty. This is a clean null report and the next cycle's starting point, not a promotion.

3. Failure triage of every canonical arm to date

2021 is adverse for G1, K11, O2 (both productions) and H3 -- the only broadly adverse canonical year -- while 2024 is favourable for every survivor; 2026 reverses the return-state family (H2/H3 +0.0008) but not K11/O2. The r20 single-arm noise scale is 0.0001-0.0002 pooled, i.e. ~0.0003-0.0006 per year: most per-year swings are within it; 2021's +0.0013/+0.0014 (G1, O2) and 2024's -0.0012 (H3) are not, which makes 2021 the era-break candidate to test rather than explain.

Per-year cells ×1e-3. Multiplicity: simultaneous max-t 95% critical value 2.95 over this cycle's 14 blocks × 2 productions — no single-block interval claim survives it. Formulas: horse_relz_gap_30_540 = decayed mean (half-life 30 d) of strictly prior y_rel_z minus the 540 d decayed mean of the same observations; horse_relz_gap_90_540 = decayed mean (half-life 90 d) of strictly prior y_rel_z minus the 540 d decayed mean of the same observations; horse_relz_gap_180_540 = decayed mean (half-life 180 d) of strictly prior y_rel_z minus the 540 d decayed mean of the same observations; horse_relz_gap_365_540 = decayed mean (half-life 365 d) of strictly prior y_rel_z minus the 540 d decayed mean of the same observations; horse_relz_last3_minus_540 = undecayed mean of the last 3 prior y_rel_z observations minus the 540 d decayed mean over all prior observations; NaN with < 3 prior; horse_relz_last6_minus_540 = undecayed mean of the last 6 prior y_rel_z observations minus the 540 d decayed mean over all prior observations; NaN with < 6 prior; horse_relz_ewm_60_x_post2020 = horse_relz_ewm_60 x 1{Date >= 2020-09-01} (centred within race); the era boundary is the 2020-21 season start, fixed here before scoring; horse_relz_era_departure_540 = 540 d decayed mean of y_rel_z over prior starts in the CURRENT era (post-2020-09 vs pre) minus the 540 d mean over all prior starts; 0 when all prior starts are in the current era; horse_relz_season_stage_departure_540 = 540 d decayed mean of y_rel_z over prior starts in today's season stage (Sep-Nov / Dec-Feb / Mar-May / Jun-Jul) minus the 540 d mean over all prior starts; season_days_x_layoff = within-race centred layoff_log x days since the season started (1 Sep) scaled to [0,1]; a dumb dense variant; horse_relz_going_departure_eradecay_365 = 365 d decayed mean of y_rel_z over prior starts in today's going class (firm / good / soft, by going_ord bands 8+, 7, <=6) minus the 365 d mean over all prior starts; horse_relz_field_regime_departure_540 = 540 d decayed mean of y_rel_z over prior starts in today's field-size regime (<=9 / 10-12 / 13-14) minus the 540 d mean over all prior starts; going_year_mean_departure = DUMB: today's going_ord minus the trailing-365 d mean going_ord of all races (race-level, so it enters only via the within-race interaction with early_style_ewm, race-centred); rail_offset_departure_meeting_decay = DUMB: today's rail_offset minus the 90 d decayed mean rail_offset at the same course letter, x within-race centred draw_pct (rail-aware draw).

6. Market-evolution controls (u06; diagnostic, not features)

market loss ranges 1.933 (2019) to 2.099 (2016): the 2016 market was the least sharp, 2019 the sharpest; B0's edge is widest in 2024 (-0.0097) and 2021 (-0.0083) and collapses in 2022 (-0.0009) the P0 scale steps 3.5 -> 3.0 -> 2.5 across 2016-2021 and stays at 2.5; blend and temperature by year are recorded here a block's favourable year that coincides with a year of unusually low market sharpness (high market loss) is a market weakness the block happened to ride, not a regime the block detected; 2021 -- adverse for most survivors -- is a year of ordinary market sharpness (1.999) and wide B0 edge, so the survivors' 2021 failure is not a market artifact

6b. Era-specific temperature, blend and scale cells (u12; instrument work, not features)

temperature map (binned by field size x surface, global fallback), global market blend weight, P0 probit scale -- fitted on the cell's prequential OOF margins. Unchanged: the boosters (C's 37 columns, 400 rounds, 3-fold prequential), the members, the panel. Cells (declared before scoring): expanding = all prior years (production; must reproduce C exactly on both paths); oof_only = all prior years, excluding the prequential market-fallback rows (fold < 0); trailing_1y = calendar years >= Y-1; trailing_2y = calendar years >= Y-2; trailing_3y = calendar years >= Y-3; trailing_5y = calendar years >= Y-5 (calibration-side twin of O3's five-year rolling window); trailing_3y_oof_only = calendar years >= Y-3 and fold >= 0; post_break_2020 = race date >= 2020-09-01 when Y >= 2021 (2020/21 season, calendar metadata); else expanding. Cells with fewer than 300 races fall back to expanding. Gate: the expanding cell reproduces production's own scoring to 0.0e+00 (B0) / 0.0e+00 (P0) on 5898 races, and t01's cached C to 0.0e+00 / 0.0e+00.

9. Integration and next step

Nothing to integrate: no block reached production-finalist and hkjc-mod was not written to. The prospective route for the t survivors (H2/H3, K11, O2) is unchanged by this campaign; the calibration-drift diagnostic belongs with the link/instrument work (blend and scale by era), not with features.
